column1: # The checks of shell/form-set-disable-if.nsh. See check-shell-log.sh.
# Hidden and the PASSWORD, in a form under a true DISABLE_IF outside forms, are no questions, with
# every --include, and Shown, in a SUPPRESS_IF on Hidden, is not suppressed; O shows no byte of the
# password; After and Later may be disabled, as the checks of the reasons, which stop before their
# section sign, which the aarch64 console prints as ?, tell

column3: .responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | startswith("3 <selectable or disabled: it relies on EFI_IFR_EQ_ID_VAL, where a DISABLE_IF outside forms must only rely on constants (UEFI 2.11 "))

.responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | startswith("4 <selectable or disabled: it is after an EFI_IFR_SUPPRESS_IF in the scope of a DISABLE_IF of its FormSet, whose condition is TRUE: edk2-stable202608 SetupBrowserDxe/IfrParse.c takes that condition for the DISABLE_IF's, which may skip the rest of its scope (:1690-1704, :3045-3059), where UEFI 2.11 "))
.responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | startswith("<ValueUnavailable: its bytes hold a password>"))
^  00000010: BB BB BB BB BB BB BB BB- +\*\.{8}\*$

column1: # The PASSWORD is a setup password question, which no setup browser asks for in the UEFI Shell

column3: . == {"error_message": "this HiiDB declares a setup password question, and the UEFI Shell runs no setup browser, so no password is asked or checked; pass --i-am-fine-to-brick-this-system to write without it"}

column1: # and --i-am-fine-to-brick-this-system selects no Hidden, nor After or Later without disabled
# questions included, and writes no byte of the password

column3: .error_message | startswith("cannot tell whether question \"After\" is disabled: it relies on EFI_IFR_EQ_ID_VAL, where a DISABLE_IF outside forms must only rely on constants (UEFI 2.11 ") and endswith("; also include disabled questions to select it regardless")

.error_message | startswith("cannot tell whether question \"Later\" is disabled: it is after an EFI_IFR_SUPPRESS_IF in the scope of a DISABLE_IF of its FormSet, whose condition is TRUE: edk2-stable202608 SetupBrowserDxe/IfrParse.c takes that condition for the DISABLE_IF's, which may skip the rest of its scope (:1690-1704, :3045-3059), where UEFI 2.11 ") and endswith("; also include disabled questions to select it regardless")
.error_message | endswith("holds a password at bytes 8..24, which set never writes")

column1: # With disabled questions included, it writes the bytes of After and Later alone

column3: .responses | length == 1 and (.[0].question.answer | startswith("9 <selectable or disabled: it relies on EFI_IFR_EQ_ID_VAL, where a DISABLE_IF outside forms must only rely on constants (UEFI 2.11 ")) and .[0].modified == true
